title: Origin Realms
description: Play vanilla survival multiplayer like its modded Minecraft!
body:
Origin Realms is a vanilla survival Minecraft server that adds brand new gameplay without the need for mods.

Our most recent update added the Aether as an official collaboration with the Aether team. Check it out!
